name: Can I replace sliding door weatherstripping myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace sliding door weatherstripping myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While replacing some types of weatherstripping can be a DIY project, especially for simple peel-and-stick applications, many sliding door systems require professional installation. Incorrectly installed weatherstripping can be ineffective, leading to continued drafts and energy loss, or even damage to the door itself. A professional ensures proper material selection, precise measurement, and correct installation for maximum effectiveness and longevity, which is particularly important for the larger, heavier sliding doors common in the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple replacements can be DIY, but complex sliding door systems often require professional installation for correct material selection and effective sealing.
